contextReview.basis: Direct review: clear, sunny daytime East Asian urban running routes: a tree-lined riverside promenade with a city skyline, a sloping residential lane with a stone step, a shaded pavement past hedges and low apartment blocks, a street-side drinking fountain, and a riverside railing with apartment blocks and a bridge; hard direct sun with sharp shadows, blue sky and a visible sheen of sweat on skin. No rain is depicted; the wet paving at the fountain is fountain water. The East Asian urban region and the humid setting are the producer's reviewed mapping; humid is a styling setting, not a measurement. Mixed adult model casting is independent of the location.

casting.castingPolicy: mixed adult model appearance independent of the East Asian urban location (user 2026-11-03)

approval.evidence: The handoff and READY.json record that the user explicitly approved these five female running editorials and full automation of this batch (userApprovedEditorials true, currentBatchExplicitAuthorization true; 2026-11-07). Product images passed producer technical QA and producer visual QA on four backgrounds only.

reconstructionNotice: The drinking fountain, its water and the street behind are the setting, not products. She leans forward to drink, so the tank's back, the shorts' back and the cap's rear are conservatively reconstructed, and the watch dial is inferred. Both runners and both socks are visible and listed as pairs. Brand, fibre composition, performance and retail identity are unknown.

findings: Actual worn silhouettes, colors and accessories matched. Hidden fronts restored conservatively.

deck.ko: 하늘색과 네이비 사이에 크림 러너를 더했습니다.
deck.en: Pale blue and navy meet cream runners.
deck.de: Hellblau und Marineblau treffen auf cremefarbene Laufschuhe.

intro.ko: 음수대 버튼을 누르고 손에 물을 받는 짧은 휴식입니다.
intro.en: Pressing the fountain button makes room for a brief drink.
intro.de: Ein Druck auf den Brunnenknopf schafft einen kurzen Trinkmoment.

body.ko: 연한 블루 탱크와 네이비 쇼츠는 같은 색 계열 안에서 명도를 나눕니다. 캡은 쇼츠 색을 반복하고 흰 양말과 크림 신발이 아래쪽을 밝힙니다. 탱크의 작은 어깨 선과 쇼츠의 흰 테두리가 과한 장식 없이 연결됩니다.
body.en: The pale blue tank and navy shorts divide light and dark within one color family. A cap repeats the shorts' navy, while white socks and cream shoes brighten the lower half. Small shoulder details and white shorts edging connect the pieces without extra decoration.
body.de: Hellblaues Tanktop und marineblaue Shorts teilen eine Farbfamilie in helle und dunkle Töne. Die Kappe wiederholt das Marineblau, weiße Socken und cremefarbene Schuhe hellen den unteren Bereich auf. Kleine Schulterdetails und weiße Kanten verbinden die Teile.

pull.en: A pause can keep the rhythm going.

copy.pullQuoteEn: A pause can keep the rhythm going.

tip.ko: 챙을 시야에 걸리지 않게 두고 캡과 쇼츠의 네이비를 맞추세요.
tip.en: Keep the brim clear of your sight and repeat navy through cap and shorts.
tip.de: Den Schirm aus dem Sichtfeld halten und Marineblau in Kappe und Shorts wiederholen.

howToWear.en: Wear over navy shorts to separate the two blue tones.
